activity.notes: Pinochet assumed executive authority under the title Jefe Supremo de la Nación in late June 1974. This short institutional phase ends immediately before he assumed the title President of the Republic on 17 December 1974.

sources.title: Decreto Ley N° 1 — Acta de Constitución de la Junta de Gobierno, Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile
sources.citation_text: Decree Law No. 1, dated 11 September 1973, constituted the Government Junta and designated General Augusto Pinochet as President of the Junta from that date.

sources.title: El Golpe de Estado y sus consecuencias para la memoria histórica — Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile
sources.citation_text: The Chilean congressional library records Pinochet becoming Supreme Chief of the Nation in late June 1974 and assuming the title President of the Republic on 17 December 1974.

sources.title: Augusto Pinochet Ugarte (1915-2006) — Memoria Chilena, Biblioteca Nacional de Chile
sources.citation_text: Chile's National Library records Pinochet as head of the military regime after the 11 September 1973 coup, President from December 1974, and handing presidential power to Patricio Aylwin on 11 March 1990.
